$comment: English overlay for dsh-science/data/workflow.json. Indexed by stage id and stage.gate id; anything missing falls back to the Chinese source and is reported in the API response as a fallback key.

S0.label: Question and scope
S0.goal: Shrink "I want to work on this area" into one sentence that can be falsified and finished within a year.

S1.label: Literature and state of the art
S1.goal: Know how far this question has been taken, and leave a verifiable search record.

S2.label: Hypothesis and design
S2.goal: Pick a design a reviewer would accept, and settle its preconditions one by one.

S3.label: Sample size and preregistration
S3.goal: Lock the sample size, primary outcome, and analysis plan before the first participant is recruited, and register it publicly.

S4.label: Materials and measurement
S4.goal: Tie every variable to a concrete measurement action, and record its precision and calibration.

S5.label: Data collection
S5.goal: Collect data per the protocol, and leave the collection itself auditable.

S6.label: Data management
S6.goal: Someone else should be able to understand this dataset and run it without you.

S7.label: Statistical analysis
S7.goal: Run the pre-specified method, report effect sizes with intervals, and report the assumption checks too.

S8.label: Figures and tables
S8.goal: A figure should read on its own, fit the page directly, and stay distinguishable for colour-blind readers and in greyscale print.

S9.label: Writing
S9.goal: Write to the target journal's structure, with every claim pointing at one piece of evidence or one result record.

S10.label: Internal review
S10.goal: Attack your own paper the way a reviewer would, before submission.

S11.label: Submission and revision
S11.goal: Build to the journal's requirements, submit, and answer every revision point instead of arguing.

S0.question.label: Research question is one sentence
S0.question.fix: Fill in question: population + variable + comparison + time point

S0.domain.label: Discipline identified
S0.domain.fix: Provide domain or targetJournal so the matcher can decide the discipline

S0.ethics.label: Ethics and data licence recorded
S0.ethics.fix: Pass ethics and dataLicense to science_project_open; even "not applicable" must be written down

S0.scope.label: Scope fits within one study
S0.scope.fix: Self-check: can you recruit the sample, book the equipment, obtain the data, and finish in time

S1.search.label: At least one search performed
S1.search.fix: science_lit_query or science_search; put the search scope in the record

S1.papers.label: At least 10 papers in the library
S1.papers.fix: Add databases and search strings; results from a single database are not a review

S1.fulltext.label: Full text available for key papers
S1.fulltext.fix: Use the science_fulltext_hunting workflow to locate open-access versions

S1.gap.label: Gap located
S1.gap.fix: science_gap_matrix: lay out established findings and open questions as a matrix

S1.coverage.label: Search strings and time window reproducible
S1.coverage.fix: Record: databases, search strings, time window, inclusion/exclusion criteria, search date

S2.design.label: Design chosen
S2.design.fix: science_discipline_profile shows the designs in this field, then specify one with science_exp_plan

S2.hypothesis.label: Hypothesis is falsifiable
S2.hypothesis.fix: Write it as "X causes Y because Z; observing not-Y refutes it"

S2.outcome.label: Exactly one primary outcome, defined
S2.outcome.fix: Keep one primary outcome; label the rest secondary or exploratory

S2.requires.label: Design preconditions settled one by one
S2.requires.fix: The requires list from science_exp_plan is a checklist; tick every item

S2.threats.label: Main threats have countermeasures
S2.threats.fix: Every threat needs a mitigation; listing threats without countermeasures counts as not done

S2.controls.label: Controls and blinding are sound
S2.controls.fix: Self-check: what the control group is compared against, who is blinded, what breaks the blind

S3.sample.label: Sample size is justified
S3.sample.fix: Give an effect size to compute n, or a given n to compute the MDE; both routes need numbers

S3.power.label: Power and alpha declared
S3.power.fix: Default α = 0.05 and power = 0.80; use 0.90 for replication studies

S3.cluster.label: Design effect computed for clustered designs
S3.cluster.fix: When randomising by class, village, or ward, pass clusterSize and icc

S3.prereg.label: Preregistration submitted with an id
S3.prereg.fix: Post the prereg draft to OSF/PROSPERO and put the DOI into the project card

S3.stopping.label: Stopping rules and exclusions fixed in advance
S3.stopping.fix: Self-check: when recruitment stops, which data is void, and who decides

S4.measure.label: Every variable has a measurement definition
S4.measure.fix: The measurements section of science_discipline_profile gives units, procedure, outputs, and calibration

S4.instruments.label: Instruments and scales in place
S4.instruments.fix: Self-check: scale licences, equipment bookings, consumables delivered, software licences

S4.calibration.label: Calibration and pilot done
S4.calibration.fix: Self-check: where the calibration record is, how many pilot cases, whether pilot data is excluded

S5.data.label: Data files under data/
S5.data.fix: Keep raw data in data/, not in code/ or the repository root

S5.run.label: At least one recorded run
S5.run.fix: science_exp_run: record input/output hashes, environment, and seed together

S5.dictionary.label: Data dictionary written
S5.dictionary.fix: For each column: meaning, unit, value domain, missing-value code (NA must not be confused with 0)

S5.raw-untouched.label: Raw data not overwritten
S5.raw-untouched.fix: Write cleaning output to data/clean/; keep the raw files read-only

S6.env.label: Environment pinned
S6.env.fix: science_exp_run writes env.json automatically; add requirements/lock as well

S6.code.label: Analysis code under code/
S6.code.fix: Name analysis scripts run.py and keep them in code/, one script per task

S6.missing.label: Missing-data strategy decided
S6.missing.fix: Report the missing proportion first, then choose deletion or imputation; imputation needs a sensitivity analysis

S6.outlier.label: Outlier rules fixed in advance
S6.outlier.fix: State the criterion, the handling, and the results both before and after handling

S7.analysis.label: Primary analysis run
S7.analysis.fix: science_stats: read assumptions first, then p

S7.effect.label: Effect size and confidence interval reported
S7.effect.fix: A p-value-only analysis is incomplete; switch to a test that reports effectSize or compute it

S7.assumptions.label: No unresolved assumption failures
S7.assumptions.fix: If assumptions fail, rerun with an alternative test listed in the warnings from science_stats

S7.multiplicity.label: Multiple-comparison policy applied
S7.multiplicity.fix: Do not correct the primary hypothesis but declare it; correct the rest per the pre-specified policy (holm/BH)

S7.sensitivity.label: At least one robustness check done
S7.sensitivity.fix: Non-parametric counterpart, rerun without outliers, or swap a covariate — pick one and report agreement

S8.figure.label: At least one figure produced
S8.figure.fix: science_figure: size figures in millimetres to the journal's spec

S8.ready.label: Figure passes the journal self-check
S8.ready.fix: Check: font ≥ 6 pt, raster ≥ 300 dpi, a vector format present

S8.errbars.label: Error-bar meaning declared
S8.errbars.fix: SD / SEM / 95% CI must be stated in the caption; never mix them

S8.tables.label: Main table readable on its own
S8.tables.fix: Self-check: every column has a unit, every group an n, every statistic a df

S9.journal.label: Target journal chosen
S9.journal.fix: Pick with science_journal_fit, or pass targetJournal directly

S9.lint.label: No blocking lint issues
S9.lint.fix: science_manuscript_lint; blocking issues must be fixed before building outputs

S9.reporting.label: Reporting guideline checked item by item
S9.reporting.fix: science_reporting_standards: CONSORT/PRISMA/ARRIVE etc., chosen by design

S9.unverified.label: No unmarked unverified claims
S9.unverified.fix: For each [unverified] passage either add evidence or demote it to a limitation

S10.audit.label: Manuscript audited
S10.audit.fix: science_paper_audit: score item by item against reviewer dimensions

S10.prov.label: Provenance chain verifies
S10.prov.fix: science_provenance; if the chain breaks, resolve it before writing the methods section

S10.repro.label: Reproducibility checklist met
S10.repro.fix: The L1–L4 levels from science_reproducibility; reach at least L2 (runnable)

S10.figs.label: Figures match the numbers in the text
S10.figs.fix: Spot-check: every n and every p in the text is traceable to an analysis record

S11.format.label: Typesetting environment check passes
S11.format.fix: science_format_check: install missing packages first; any downgrade must be stated in the submission notes

S11.route.label: Submission route confirmed
S11.route.fix: science_submission_route: system, file naming, author order, conflict-of-interest statement

S11.cover.label: Cover letter written
S11.cover.fix: science_cover_letter: one paragraph on the gap, two on the findings, one on fit to this journal

S11.rebuttal.label: Every revision point answered
S11.rebuttal.fix: science_rebuttal: one response per comment; change what you can, and give reasons plus alternatives where you cannot

globalRules: Missing means skip: unfindable, unrunnable, or absent data is always marked skip with what is missing — never pass.

Freeze before analysing: design, primary outcome, sample size, and analysis plan are fixed before looking at the data. Changing the plan after seeing data must be declared exploratory in the manuscript.
Effect sizes and intervals first: a result reporting only a p-value is incomplete in this application.
Every number traceable: each n and p in the text must map to an entry in an analysis or run record.
No acceptance predictions: this application gives no probability of acceptance and no judgement beyond journal tiering.
